ruling_text:
Case Number:
24AHCV00006
Hearing Date:
March 9, 2026
Dept:
X
#19 -
MARGARITO RAMIREZ GUERRERO vs GEORGE L. THROOP COMPANY
Plaintiff’s Motion for Preliminary Approval of Class Action
and PAGA Settlement is GRANTED. The Settlement Agreement is preliminarily
approved as fair, reasonable, and adequate, and within the range of possible
final approval.
The parties and the Settlement Administrator shall adhere to
the following schedule:
Notice to Class Members:
The Administrator shall mail
the Notice Packet to all Class Members no later than 14 calendar days after
receiving the Class Data from Defendant.
Exclusion/Objection Deadline:
Requests for exclusion
and written objections must be postmarked or submitted to the Administrator no
later than 45 calendar days after the initial mailing of the Notice Packet.
Motion for Final Approval and Motion for Attorney’s Fees,
Costs, and Service Award:
Plaintiff shall file these motions no later than 16
court days before the Final Approval Hearing.
Failure to file the Parties’
Motion for Final Approval of Class Action Settlement by this deadline will
result in a continuance of the final approval hearing to the Court’s first
available hearing date, which could be months after the hearing date noted below.
The Parties’ Motion for Final Approval of Class Action
Settlement must include a concurrently lodged single document that constitutes
a [Proposed] Order and Judgment containing among other things, the class
definition, full release language, and names of the any class members who opted
out.
Final Approval Hearing:
A Final Approval Hearing
shall be held on
July 1, 2026 at 8:30 a.m.
in Department X of Alhambra
Courthouse, to determine whether the settlement should be finally approved as
fair, reasonable, and adequate.
Upon final approval, the Court shall enter a Judgment that
dismisses the Action with prejudice.  The
Judgment will be binding on all Participating Class Members who do not timely
and validly opt out and on all Aggrieved Employees as to the PAGA claims.  The Judgment will incorporate the release of
claims as set forth in the Settlement Agreement and will bar any future
litigation on the Released Class Claims and Released PAGA Claims.
